about:
Vermont Custom Handrails & Metalwork operates from a fabrication shop in Hyde Park, Vermont. The company was founded in 2021 by James Lambert, a master fabricator with more than twenty years of specialized metalworking experience. Lambert started the business to work directly with homeowners and architects, translating structural requirements into custom architectural centerpieces.

The shop produces custom stair and railing systems for both residential and commercial projects. Capabilities include floating stairs, wood-framed and steel-framed staircases, stainless steel handrail and cable railing systems, spiral staircases, and ADA-compliant railings. Every component is custom-fabricated on site using high-grade stainless steel by a team whose combined fabrication experience exceeds sixty years. The company also offers turnkey packages that cover design, fabrication, and installation, along with optional LED lighting integrated into handrails and monorail stairs.

Clients range from private homeowners building lakefront retreats and mountain lodges to architects and commercial contractors needing code-compliant railing systems. The firm serves Vermont, New Hampshire, New York, and the wider New England region, and has completed more than four hundred projects since inception.

Lambert emphasizes a collaborative process that begins with an in-home consultation, proceeds through custom design and fabrication, and ends with a clean installation and rigorous safety inspection. The company positions its blend of heavy-duty engineering and clean, modern lines as a differentiator, aiming to deliver structurally sound, visually striking results that are tailored to each space.
